university.name: Brunel University of London
university.summary: Brunel University London is based in Uxbridge and describes its campus as a London campus. It teaches undergraduate and postgraduate taught programmes and has students from over 100 countries. It also runs a pathway college and lists dedicated international scholarships and discounts.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of student sponsors, file dated 2026-10-07, listed as Brunel University London, Student route)

courses.title: Computer Science BSc (Hons)
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time, or 4 years full-time with placement
courses.overview: A three-year full-time computing degree, with a four-year option that includes a placement year. First-year study is compulsory and covers programming, logic, data and information systems, and a group project. The placement year carries a separate fee.
courses.academic_requirements: Standard offer ABB at A-level or 31 points in the IB Diploma, with GCSE Mathematics grade 4/C and English Language grade 4/C (or English Literature grade 5/B). Contextual offer BBB or 30 IB points.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall (minimum 5.5 in all areas); Pearson 59 (59 in all subscores); BrunELT 6.5 (minimum 5.5 in all areas); TOEFL 5 (minimum 4 in all subscores).
courses.notes: Page shows September start for 2026/27 entry only, so no 2027 intake label is recorded. Fee is 2026/27 (target year fee not yet published); placement year fee is GBP 1,955. TOEFL requirement is shown on the page as '5', which looks like a different scoring scale, so min_toefl is left null.

courses.title: Finance and Accounting MSc
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time (longer full-time options with placement are also listed)
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in finance and accounting, with longer routes that include a placement. Compulsory study covers finance foundations, financial reporting, investment valuation and data analytics, plus a dissertation. Optional modules cover areas such as corporate and behavioural finance.
courses.academic_requirements: 2:2 (or above) UK Honours degree, or an equivalent internationally recognised qualification, in Economics and Accountancy, Finance and Accountancy, or Mathematical subjects, with a minimum background in mathematics or statistics, accountancy, and economics or finance.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (minimum 6 in all areas); Pearson 59 (59 in all subscores); BrunELT 6.5 (minimum 6 in all areas); TOEFL 5 (minimum 4.5 in all subscores).
courses.notes: Page lists January and September starts without a 2027 year, so no intake label is recorded. Fee is 2026/27 (target year fee not yet published) and the page says fees are subject to annual increase. Modules shown are year 1 compulsory; optional modules exist. No Pakistan-specific academic threshold found.

courses.title: Data Science and Analytics MSc
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time (15 month and 2 year placement routes also listed)
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in data science, with longer routes that include a placement. The module list is compulsory and covers machine learning, data visualisation, modern data and the ethics of digital systems, followed by a dissertation project.
highlights: Ethics and Governance of Digital Systems
courses.academic_requirements: A 2:2 or above UK Honours degree, or equivalent internationally recognised qualification, from a scientific, engineering or numerate subject. Other qualifications with relevant industrial experience are assessed individually and may need an interview or aptitude tests.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 (minimum 6 in all areas); Pearson 59 (59 in all subscores); BrunELT 6.5 (minimum 6 in all areas); TOEFL 5 (minimum 4.5 in all subscores).
courses.notes: Page lists January and September starts without a 2027 year, so no intake label is recorded. Fee is 2026/27 (target year fee not yet published). The page gives no international academic grade table in the fetched text. Part-time routes also exist; full-time fee only recorded.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's Postgraduate International Excellence Award
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,000 tuition fee reduction, applied for one year of full-time study, or two years for full-time courses running over two years (as published for 2026/27)
scholarships.summary: An automatic fee reduction for self-funded overseas fee-paying applicants to full-time taught master's or MRes courses who hold a UK 2:1 or equivalent. The published terms cover 2026/27 starts; 2027/28 terms are not yet published.
scholarships.criteria_text: Overseas fee status, self-funded, UK 2:1 or above or equivalent internationally recognised degree, offer for a full-time PGT or MRes course, GBP 5,000 deposit paid by the advisory deadline.
scholarships.deadline_note: Advisory deadlines on the 2026/27 terms: 31 August 2026 (September 2026 entry) and 30 November 2026 (January 2027 entry). Deferral to 2027/28 forfeits the award; 2027/28 terms not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Cannot be combined with other awards except the 2% prompt payment discount and the Graduate Discount. Not for part-time, online, distance, PG Cert, PG Dip or Brunel Pathway College routes.

scholarships.name: Beaconhouse School Discount
scholarships.value_text: 20% tuition fee waiver per year for up to three years (up to GBP 4,359 on a tuition fee of GBP 21,795 for September 2026)
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition fee waiver for current Beaconhouse students in Pakistan who hold a Brunel undergraduate offer for direct first year entry. It cannot be combined with other University awards, and MBBS offer holders are excluded.
scholarships.criteria_text: Current Beaconhouse students with an undergraduate offer in Pakistan, direct first year entry, meeting the conditions on the Brunel offer letter. MBBS applicants are not eligible.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated. Fee example on the page is for September 2026.
scholarships.intake_label: Fee example given for September 2026; 2027 terms not stated
scholarships.notes: Only relevant to applicants who are current Beaconhouse students. The most beneficial single award is applied where several could apply.

scholarships.name: Early Payment Discount
scholarships.value_text: 2% discount on the net course fee for paying fees in full at or before registration
scholarships.summary: A 2% reduction on the net course fee for self-funded students who pay their full fees at or before their scheduled registration date. It is calculated after any other discounts and does not apply where a third party pays the fees.
scholarships.criteria_text: Students responsible for paying their own fees in full, paying at or before the scheduled registration date. Not available where a third party pays any part of the fees.
scholarships.deadline_note: Payment due on or before the scheduled registration date.
scholarships.intake_label: Entry year not stated on the page
scholarships.notes: Page does not say whether the discount applies per year of study or once. value_basis per_year is an assumption to be confirmed, so the client should check.

scholarships.name: Brunel Graduate Discount
scholarships.value_text: 15% discount on the net tuition fee for every year of study
scholarships.summary: An alumni discount for self-funded students who graduated from Brunel and register for a subsequent degree programme. It is applied after any scholarship waivers, needs no application, and is assessed once an offer is held.
scholarships.criteria_text: Previously studied at Brunel and graduated (achieved the intended award), self-funded, registering for a subsequent programme. Not available to holders of the Postgraduate International Bursary or the Vice Chancellor's Excellence Award.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; listed as open for applications.
scholarships.intake_label: Entry year not stated on the page
scholarships.notes: Site scholarships list shows it for postgraduate and postgraduate research levels. Cannot be combined with the Vice Chancellor's Postgraduate International Excellence Award.
